name: Earthjustice
mission: Founded in 1971, Earthjustice fights to preserve magnificent places and wildlife, protect people's health, advance clean energy, and combat climate change. As the premier nonprofit environmental law organization, we take on the biggest, most precedent-setting cases across the country. With more than 200 attorneys in 15 regional offices, we serve hundreds of public-interest clients, providing top-tier legal representation free of charge.
theoryOfChange: Earthjustice has a published "Justice Framework" developed by its Community, Justice, and Impact (CJI) team, introduced in 2025. This framework aims to drive strategic and operational alignment around the organization's values and mission to advance justice. It conceives of an “Ecosystem of Justice” that seeks to achieve a truly democratic multi-racial society, incorporating and serving all people and the planet. The framework allows every staff member to engage in a practice of justice that is informed, builds interconnectedness, encourages inclusive innovation, and maintains values-based accountability, and helps to gauge the organization's impact. Furthermore, Earthjustice also articulates a theory of change in the context of its clean energy program, stating that by compelling coal-fired power plants to meet environmental compliance standards, coal power will become economically uncompetitive with genuinely clean energy sources.

In FY2024, the organization reported a <cite id="2">Total Revenue of $139,607,013</cite>. Financial filings show an <cite id="2">80.0% program expense Ratio</cite> in FY2024, while score evaluations use a <cite id="1">cash-adjusted ratio of 77%</cite>.
